content.title: Chapter 102 - UTILITIES — Sec. 102-136. - Grease and grit interceptors.
content.summary:
Nonresidential facilities shall be equipped with grit or grease interceptors, or both,
               in accordance with the Uniform Plumbing Code, unless otherwise determined by the city.
(Code 1981, § 33-69; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988; Ord. No. 2931, §§ 8, 9, 10-19-1992)
